descriptions.notStarted: You found and returned Maestro Rho's MP3 player. That ought to be enough to get a new song, right? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for a new song Blake can perform during his debut concert.
descriptions.inProgress: A composition fee? Well, that's somewhat understandable since he's a brilliant composer. Find the Fancy Amplifier Cables on the 7th-8th floor and deliver them to #bMaestro Rho#k.
descriptions.completed: You have paid the fee, but he still seems reluctant to give you the song. What's up with that? Talk to #bMaestro Rho#k again.
